outcome: Every one of the 31 SAP plants in the July extract is now selectable on the MIS Reports screen and renders its own statement on the nursery format, where before only DUB could be chosen. The Department, Function and Plant selectors depend on each other: picking a plant fills in its department and function, picking a department leaves only its functions and plants, and a choice that no longer fits is cleared. The mapping master is generated by a committed script from the client's SAP mapping sheet plus a plant classification table (version 3, 31 plants, 454 cost-centre/GL triples), so a new sheet is a regeneration, not a hand edit; plants whose labels are inferred are marked 'Provisional labels'. Measured: the 31 rendered statements sum to the company net of ₹11,02,73,718.00 in exact paise, and DUB is unchanged against the frozen shipped baseline in values, tree, provenance and Excel bytes. Budget exists only for DUB in the PoC, so every other plant shows a dash for Budget, Roll-over and % (never a zero, never a percentage against nothing) on screen, in the drill and in the export, with an accessible label saying the budget is not loaded for that plant. A user's plant grants come from the seed list, so a demo user can be scoped to one plant. The assistant is untouched by this story.
